name: Mèo mướp nhà bên
style_prompt: A small Vietnamese street tabby cat (meo muop): gray-brown fur with dark tiger stripes, ringed tail, yellow-green eyes, no white fur. Hand-drawn crayon / colored-pencil texture, thick black outlines, simple chibi proportions, dot eyes, minimal flat colors, the same art style as the reference images.
